title: Call-Efficient ICD-10 Code Prediction via Supervised Candidate Generation and Selective LLM Invocation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21891v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic assignment of ICD-10 codes from short clinical diagnosis text is a practical medical text classification and normalization task. The task is difficult because diagnosis phrases are short and noisy, the ICD-10 label space is hierarchical, and the class distribution is strongly imbalanced. This paper presents a call-efficient ICD-10 code prediction pipeline that combines transformer embeddings, tree-based supervised candidate generation, candidate-level reranking, and a gated LLM assistance. The evaluation uses a leakage-safe validation protocol: model and threshold selection are based on out-of-fold cross-validation predictions, while final reporting is performed on a locked test set with no shared source-file groups. The supervised conditional parent-code candidate generator reaches 74.32% Top-1 accuracy on the locked test set and 93.05% Top-10 candidate coverage. A direct zero-shot GPT-5.6-Sol baseline reaches 81.01% Top-1 acc

translated_title: 通过监督式候选生成与选择性大语言模型调用实现高调用效率的ICD-10编码预测
translated_abstract: 从简短的临床诊断文本中自动分配ICD-10编码是一项实用的医学文本分类与规范化任务。该任务的难点在于诊断短语短且含噪、ICD-10标签空间具有层次结构，以及类别分布严重不平衡。本文提出了一种高调用效率的ICD-10编码预测流程，该流程结合了Transformer嵌入、基于树的监督式候选生成、候选级别的重排序以及门控式大语言模型辅助。评估采用了防泄漏的验证协议：模型与阈值选择基于折外交叉验证预测，而最终结果报告则在无共享源文件组的锁定测试集上进行。监督式条件父编码候选生成器在锁定测试集上达到了74.32%的Top-1准确率和93.05%的Top-10候选覆盖率。直接的零样本GPT-5.6-Sol基线达到了81.01%的Top-1准确率。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合监督式候选生成、候选重排序与门控式选择性LLM调用的高效ICD-10编码预测流程，在防泄漏验证协议下实现高准确率的同时降低大语言模型调用成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a call-efficient ICD-10 coding pipeline combining supervised candidate generation, candidate-level reranking, and gated selective LLM invocation, achieving high accuracy while reducing LLM call costs under a leakage-safe validation protocol.
